changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'fusion' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AgentErrorItem_backup') BEGIN drop table fusion.AgentErrorItem_backup; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'fusion' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AgentErrorItem_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [fusion].[AgentErrorItem_backup]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [AgentErrorID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [Date] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_FusionAgentErrorItem_Date] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](max) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionAgentErrorItem] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
